name: ghost-reader
title: Ghost Reader (虚影读取器)
author: INFIcer
description: Adds a custom constant-combinator style entity (Ghost Reader) with a custom GUI panel. It reads ghosts (buildings | tiles | upgrades | temporary item requests — ghost items placed on a tile in remote view), and outputs the per-item counts as circuit signals, either for the whole surface or for its logistics network's construction area. 添加自定义恒压器式实体「虚影读取器」：读取建筑|地格|升级|临时物品请求（远程视图下在储物格上放置的幽灵物品），按物品把数量输出为电路信号，可选择整个表面或所在物流网络的建设范围。
